candidates.summary: World-scoped abundance/subsidy profile: owner establishes extreme prosperity and broad subsidization; detailed immigration tiers, quotas, housing/resource tiering and ration rules remain proposals.
Household maintenance-mite care/routine interactions as a setting-specific CEL routine/activity profile.
Mite Credits subsidy concept for households hosting healthy maintenance swarms; currency/reward semantics must route through MIB-13.
High-stakes wager, portal-fee, insurance/re-roll cost and recovery-service context as Black-Vegas-scoped market/opportunity material.
Neutral-nexus trade plus concept-wagering activity profile; values, safety, consent and stakes are unresolved and not CEL-owned.
Commercial-associate/protectorate/full-integration economic service concepts including trade access, franchises, tribute and unified currency.
CEL scheduling/profile hook must accept owner-established 32-hour days and 320-day years through World/calendar authority; assistant split-day work/rest patterns remain proposals.
Official portal trade hubs, interworld commerce and shadow-economy context along the 30 Winds, owned downstream by WCI/MSS-10/MIB-13.
Reagent wetlands/alchemical agriculture/resources as future production and local-market context; no yields or prices adopted.
Markets, shops, exports and cross-reality cuisine/hospitality context for later setting-specific CEL profiles; chronology guardrails remain World-owned.
Mana-driven mining/energy/production/economy context, gated on MSS/WCI definition of actual mana resources.
79-model post-scarcity social-structure proposal library. No model is selected; no nonmaterial status metric silently becomes currency.
Overt-game realities may identify as life/crafting/social games with quest contracts/reputation/rewards; CEL can present approved activities but WCI/SGC own the reality-game contract.

boundaries.detail: Owner asks for a range of possibilities; the 79 assistant models are not an owner selection or canon decision.
Contribution, reputation, attention, access, trust, novelty, time or prestige systems may not silently become a universal replacement currency or gate necessities without explicit setting authority.
Extreme prosperity and broad subsidization are owner-grounded; exact population, immigration tiers, quotas, rationing and resource-tier details are assistant proposals.
Owner-authored manufactured-scarcity premise belongs to the fictional alternate-Earth setting and cannot be generalized into real-world economics or universal Multiversal economy rules.
CEL uses governed in-world time and must not hardcode a 24-hour day; Pencrona’s owner-established 32-hour day is a World/calendar input, not a CEL-owned calendar.
Longer or unusual setting days do not authorize wall-clock-to-game-progress or unattended simulation; CEL-04 bounded authorization still controls advancement.
Mite Credits and household subsidies are assistant-generated; MIB-13 must own any future currency/reward implementation.
Recovered assistant portal fees, wager costs and insurance values are setting proposals, not canonical prices and never universal price references.
Identity/ability/time/truth wagering is assistant-generated and implicates consent/ownership/irreversibility; CEL automation cannot authorize such stakes.
Unified currency, tribute and franchise/service terms are assistant-generated integration proposals; MIB-13 and WCI must own any adoption.
Mana cannot be priced, mined or scheduled as CEL production until MSS/WCI establish the actual resource identities and constraints.
A gamified reality may expose rewards/shops/reputation, but its game-system authority is not created by CEL; CEL only composes approved owner-domain actions.
